lines.trans: Hey, kid, have you ever made a toy shooter?
No, I have never made one.
Want me to teach you?
Yes, I want to very much!
Then run, go grab a clothespin quickly!
And where do I get it?
Look in the kitchen, on the line.
I will tell your mother everything!
Klavdia Viktorovna, don't scare the child!
She will give you to an orphanage!
Don't listen to her, Lyosha.
Or she will sell you to us!
There has been no trial yet, grandma!
Go away from here, cursed Arkashka!
